subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the vehicle shown in <Picture 1> — a vibrant blue metallic Audi Q3 compact five-door SUV. Preserve 100% exactly: the bright blue metallic paint, Audi hexagonal single-frame front grille with chrome border and vertical chrome slats, the four-ring Audi emblem centered on the grille, sharp angular full-LED headlights with segmented daytime-running-light signatures, sculpted hood with character lines, body-colored blue side mirrors, silver multi-spoke alloy wheels, black plastic wheel-arch cladding and lower body trim, silver roof rails, dark-tinted windows, front bumper with silver accent trim, and the compact premium SUV proportions. Preserve the exact wheelbase, roof height, hood length, windshield angle, window geometry, wheel size, fender shape, grille dimensions, headlight shape and bumper design in every shot. The car must remain physically identical from frame to frame and shot to shot. No color shift, no body-style change, no grille redesign, no wheel change.
<Subject 2> is the environment. No reference image — described in text only: a journey that moves from warm sunset asphalt, through autumn woodland, to a wet mountain road. Lighting and atmosphere shift per shot but remain physically coherent.

summary:
[reference generation] A 10-second, 16:9 photorealistic live-action automotive commercial. The blue Audi Q3 from <Picture 1> is the sole vehicle throughout. Four shots: static start from the reference three-quarter angle, lateral tracking through autumn forest, top-down drone over a winding road, and aggressive frontal approach on a wet mountain pass. Only <Picture 1> is used as a reference — it locks the vehicle identity; all environments are text-described. No text, no subtitles, no music.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1>: fully_preserved — exact blue Audi Q3 identity from <Picture 1> retained in all four exterior shots. Paint color, grille, headlights, wheels, roof rails, proportions and stance remain identical; only the vehicle's position, speed and camera angle change.
<Subject 2>: text-defined — environment is constructed from description, no reference image to preserve.

detailed_description:
Photorealistic live-action automotive commercial. Natural physically correct vehicle mass. Realistic suspension articulation. Realistic tire deformation. Realistic dust, gravel and water spray physics. Cinematic high dynamic range. Natural motion blur. Premium automotive advertising cinematography. 16:9.

[Shot 1, 0.000–2.500 seconds] The frame opens on the exact blue Audi Q3 from <Picture 1>, parked in the same three-quarter side profile on dark asphalt, warm sunset sky and tree line in the background. After approximately one second, the brake lights release, the engine settles into idle, and the SUV begins to roll forward slowly. The camera tracks laterally with small amplitude at slow speed, keeping the vehicle in the same three-quarter framing as it moves off. Natural motion blur on the wheels as they begin to turn.

[Shot 2, 2.500–5.000 seconds] HARD CUT to a fast lateral tracking shot through autumn woodland. The same blue Audi Q3 moves left-to-right at speed. Camera travels parallel at the vehicle's speed. Foreground tree trunks repeatedly sweep across the frame with strong parallax; yellow and amber leaves streak through the foreground while the vehicle stays relatively sharp. The exact side profile is maintained: five-door body, silver roof rails, black wheel-arch cladding, silver multi-spoke wheels, body-colored blue mirrors. Dust and fallen leaves kick up behind the rear wheels.

[Shot 3, 5.000–7.500 seconds] HARD CUT to a top-down drone view. The blue Audi Q3 drives along a narrow winding road through dense autumn forest — orange, amber, yellow and deep brown foliage on both sides. A soft dust trail follows behind. The drone remains directly above and slightly forward, descending slowly with small amplitude at slow speed. The silver roof rails and blue roof panel from <Picture 1> are clearly recognizable from above. Sunlight filters through the canopy in dappled patches.

[Shot 4, 7.500–10.000 seconds] HARD CUT to a low frontal three-quarter angle on a wet mountain road. Cold gray-blue grading, snow-covered peaks in the distance, heavy overcast sky. The blue Audi Q3 drives aggressively toward the camera. Brown-gray tire spray and muddy water rise from both sides. The low camera retreats backward at the vehicle's speed, keeping the front grille, LED headlights and Audi emblem centered and recognizable. The suspension visibly compresses and rebounds over uneven ground. In the final second, the vehicle passes close to the camera's left side, the blue bodywork sweeping through frame, and the frame progressively darkens to black.

[Vehicle Identity Lock — all shots] Vibrant blue metallic paint. Audi hexagonal single-frame grille with chrome border and vertical slats. Four-ring emblem. Sharp angular LED headlights with segmented DRL. Sculpted hood. Body-colored blue mirrors. Silver multi-spoke alloy wheels. Black plastic lower cladding. Silver roof rails. Dark-tinted windows. Compact premium five-door SUV proportions. No color shift. No body-style change. No grille redesign. No wheel change. No vehicle morphing. No duplicated vehicle. No extra wheels. No warped panels. No floating tires. No incorrect wheel rotation.

overall_soundscape:
Low engine rumble throughout, deepening under acceleration. Tire noise transitions from smooth asphalt in Shot 1, to gravel and leaf crunch in Shot 2 and 3, to wet-road spray and heavy engine load in Shot 4. Subtle whoosh as the vehicle passes the camera in the final shot. No music, no dialogue, no voiceover.
